newsitem.title: USA: Pacific storm gathers strength, may threaten Fiji.
newsitem.headline: Pacific storm gathers strength, may threaten Fiji.

text.p: Tropical cyclone Gavin will become a strong risk to shipping in the southwest Pacific during the next 48 hours, private forecaster Weather Services Corporation (WSC) said on Wednesday.
Winds, estimated at 70 mph, should reach 105-110 mph in 48 hours and 110-115 mph in 72 hours, it added.

The system was east of the Santa Cruz islands, well north-northwest of Fiji, but was expected to turn south during the next 24-48 hours, which meant that the islands of Fiji might be threatened later.
